tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad 2.44, near but below the proposed critical range of 2.50–2.68. A high-gradient measurement directly tests whether an avalanche onset occurs and constrains its magnitude.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the supercritical avalanche model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot barely reaches the proposed threshold, leaving its onset and strength unidentified.
A high-gradient probe more directly distinguishes the proposed threshold mechanism from smooth alternatives.
The correlated pilot inputs do not distinguish these smooth curves from a threshold response.
